questions.stem: The parents of a 10-year-old boy consulted a doctor about an extension of hair-covering, growth of beard and mustache, and low voice. Intensified secretion of which hormone must be assumed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Of Testosterone

Extension of hair-covering, growth of beard and mustache, and low voice are the signs of masculine physique development. Development of the masculine physique, development of the male reproductive system in the fetus and adolescent, and the sex drive are stimulated by testosterone.




Ganong's Review Of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page no 416

questions.stem: A 32-year-old lady is undergoing evaluation for polycystic ovary syndrome. Her sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) is low. The decrease in sex hormone-binding globulin will have the maximum effect on which of the following hormones?
questions.solutionHtml:
Testosterone

The decrease in sex hormone-binding globulin will have the maximum effect on testosterone.




Ganong's Review Of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page no 416

questions.stem: Testosterone production is mainly contributed by_______ :
questions.solutionHtml:
Leydig cells
  • Testosterone production is mainly contributed by Leydig cells.
  • Testosterone is synthesized from cholesterol in the Leydig cells and also from androstenedione secreted by the adrenal cortex.



Ganong's Review Of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page no 416-417

questions.stem: The blood-testis barrier is formed by:

options.label: A
options.text: Tight junctions between adjacent Leydig cells

options.label: B
options.text: Tight junctions between adjacent Sertoli cells

questions.answerText: Tight junctions between adjacent Sertoli cells
questions.solutionHtml:
Tight junctions between adjacent Sertoli cells

The blood-testis barrier is formed by the tight junctions between adjacent Sertoli cells.




Ganong's Review Of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page no 412.

questions.stem: The production of estradiol by the testes requires:

options.label: D
options.text: Leydig cell, Sertoli cells, LH, and FSH

questions.answerText: Leydig cell, Sertoli cells, LH, and FSH
questions.solutionHtml:
Leydig cell, Sertoli cells, LH, and FSH

The estradiol in testicular venous blood comes from the Leydig cells, but some is also produced by the aromatization of androgens in Sertoli cells and Also LH and FSH.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page Number: 409.

questions.stem: Which is a true statement regarding Inhibin?

options.label: C
options.text: It is secreted by the hypothalamus

questions.solutionHtml:
It is a glycoprotein

It is a glycoprotein-Inhibin is a glycoprotein, like both LH and FSH, with a molecular weight between 10,000 and 30,000.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 13th Edition, Page Number: 1032,1048.
